reviewFindings: SUPERSEDED: owner reverted shorts for leg visibility. Retain this as a historical draft only; regenerate from anatomical v3 before release.
Rebuilt after owner required a single athlete wearing loose gym shorts. All selected frames use the same charcoal shorts and white trainers.
Four separately generated native poses, six separate files; frames 5 and 6 reuse poses 3 and 2 for the reverse movement with distinct cues. No warping, interpolation or montage-derived frames.
Global identity and exercise master attached to every new pose generation.
Head, feet, clothing and framing appear consistent on visual inspection; shoulder shapes and upper-arm muscle colouring need further review.
The 6-to-1 transition lowers elbows and weights to the start. This is staged still-image playback, not continuous animation.

frames.caption: SET UP 1/6
frames.cue: Stand tall with light dumbbells in front of your thighs.

frames.caption: RAISE ELBOWS 2/6
frames.cue: Lead with your elbows, keeping your wrists below them.

frames.caption: ROTATE UP 3/6
frames.cue: Rotate your forearms up while keeping your elbows bent.

frames.caption: LOWER TO GOALPOST 5/6
frames.cue: Lower to the goalpost position under control.

frames.caption: ROTATE DOWN 6/6
frames.cue: Rotate your forearms down, then lower your elbows to return to the start.
